title: Collaborate with KPN
bodyHtml:
Create a new knowledge portal

The Knowledge Portal team specializes in partnering with biomedical researchers to build resources, tailored to each research community, that will accelerate their research. We welcome new collaborations.

Create a new research page

The mission of the Knowledge Portal Network is to accelerate the pace of research into the basis of human disease by facilitating researchers' access to genetic and genomic information. The full-scale Knowledge Portals, such as the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal, provide open access to large-scale, integrated results. But, what if...

  • you have generated a list of predicted effector genes for a disease or trait and would like to share it with the research community?
  • you and your collaborators need a private "sandbox" to visualize and work with your data?
  • you need to display supplementary results for reviewers of your manuscript?
  • you want to share your data with the research community, but there is not yet an interface in the Knowledge Portals to display the type of data that you've generated?

Read more here.

Contribute results

We are interested in forming collaborations around new data, methods, and tools. We encourage researchers to contact us about new data relevant to the genetics of type 1 and 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, stroke, sleep and circadian disorders, and related traits.

Contribute methods

The Human Genetics Amplifier (HuGeAMP) platform allows us to apply multiple bioinformatic methods at scale to genetic association and epigenomic data. We are actively developing new methods, and welcome collaborations.

Join our team

Future opportunities will be available here, check back soon.
